page.title: Follow-ups
page.description: Life events customers announced in a conversation. A week before, Pax gets in touch on its own with a personal email. Unlike a handover, nobody asked to speak to a person here.

due.title: Nothing is due right now
due.body: Use time travel to move forward so planned events become due.

upcoming.title: No announced events yet
upcoming.body: As soon as someone says in the chat something like “I'll graduate in two years”, it shows up here.

responded.title: No replies yet
responded.body: Follow-ups land here once someone replied or came back to the chat.

lost.title: No lost follow-ups
lost.body: If two emails go unanswered, the lead counts as lost. It reopens when the person gets in touch later.

clock.label: Time travel for the demo
clock.resetConfirm: Delete all generated follow-up leads and emails and return to today's date?
clock.working: Pax is checking follow-ups and writing the emails …

summary.opened: {count, plural, one {# follow-up opened} other {# follow-ups opened}}
summary.reminded: {count, plural, one {# reminder sent} other {# reminders sent}}
summary.lost: {count, plural, one {# lead lost without response} other {# leads lost without response}}
summary.reopened: {count, plural, one {# lead reopened} other {# leads reopened}}
summary.responded: {count, plural, one {# reply recorded} other {# replies recorded}}
summary.checkins: {count, plural, one {# yearly check-in sent} other {# yearly check-ins sent}}
summary.failed: {count, plural, one {# email could not be written, please check again} other {# emails could not be written, please check again}}

timeline.caption: {count, plural, =0 {No planned follow-ups} one {# planned follow-up from today} other {# planned follow-ups from today}}

card.noEmail: No email address on file: please call.

outbox.title: Outbox
outbox.description: Simulated: Pax sends nothing, the emails only live here.

checkin.title: Yearly check-in
checkin.description: Once a year Pax asks whether anything changed in family, work, home or income. Customers can switch it off in their pension cockpit.
checkin.empty: No customers with an email address yet.
checkin.noEmail: Yearly check-in: no email address on file.

customer.title: Follow-ups and mail
customer.description: Announced life events and the emails Pax wrote about them.

portal.title: Yearly check-in
portal.body: Once a year we briefly ask by email whether anything changed in your family, work, home or income. That keeps your pension planning up to date.
portal.noEmail: We don't have your email address yet. You can give it in the conversation with Clara.
